mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) decline, it signals a weakening economy that triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0 and RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 99.0), the supply chain constraints and reduced manufacturing output signal an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO < 99.0, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1000 thousand units, it signals robust consumer demand and economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST > 1000, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS > 0.1%) and unemployment rate is above 5.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy combined with a weak labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% and UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), elevated inflation leads to aggressive central bank policy, which reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
